dresses: save machine: round stone hearth 2.3 m across (3.1 m over the spokes), sunk bowl with a boss, four horn scrolls over the rim, eight oak spokes, iron grating round the foot
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Read from a 120-pixel frame: a stepped stone ring with a bowl, four horn scrolls, eight timber spokes and an iron grating. The original has more ornament (interlaced arcs) than is built, and nothing here moves or glows; in game the machine is animated and lit when used. Spokes share one wood material whose grain follows world X, not each spoke. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
triangle_note: 7,000 triangles: above the 6,000 soft target of class prop, spent on the ring and scrolls
